subject: Demo recap + proposed POC activation plan — ArdenHall Labs
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren McNamara <lauren.mcnamara@ardenhall.com>, Ethan Mooney <ethan.mooney@ardenhall.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC activation plan — ArdenHall Labs

Hi Lauren / Ethan,

Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed approach to get you into a short, high-velocity POC so your team can validate latency, throughput, and end-user quality for the document-assistant flow we walked through.

Top takeaways from today
- Primary goal: replace rule-based extraction + heuristic reranking with a retrieval-augmented generation flow that reduces manual triage and speeds answers for frontline agents.
- Key metrics you called out: p95 latency target for answer generation, and end-to-end accuracy measured against your internal evaluation set.
- Constraints: sample dataset contains PII; ArdenHall needs SOC2 evidence and encrypted at-rest storage.

Proposed 4-week POC (high level)
1) Week 0 (prep, 1 week): data handoff and security review — we set up a dedicated trial tenant, exchange a limited dataset (hashed/filtered) and confirm network/VPC settings.
2) Week 1 (integration): ingest sample docs, configure retrieval pipeline, baseline generation model, run smoke tests.
3) Week 2 (tuning + eval): run curated evals, iterate prompt and retrieval parameters, measure p95 latency and token costs.
4) Week 3 (validation & handoff): finalize success criteria pass/fail, run a short pilot with 50 agents, compile performance report and recommendations.

Ownership and immediate asks
- Redwood: Jonas (AE) — kickoff, timeline owner; Marissa (Solutions Engineer) — integration and evaluation runbook; Ben (Customer Success) — onboarding and adoption plan.
- ArdenHall: Lauren (Product/AI) — confirm success criteria and provide sample evaluation set; Ethan (Infra) — confirm security/VPC requirements and SOC2/contact for evidence.

Attachments: POC-activation-plan-ardenhall.pdf (high-level plan + success criteria template).

Next steps
- If this looks right, can you confirm that ArdenHall can: 1) share a filtered sample evaluation set by May 17, and 2) commit to a kickoff week of May 20?
- I'll circulate the attached POC activation PDF and a one-click HubSpot kickoff link after you confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Lauren McNamara <lauren.mcnamara@ardenhall.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Mooney <ethan.mooney@ardenhall.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC activation plan — ArdenHall Labs

Jonas,

Appreciate the clear recap — this aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side so the POC focuses on the right checks:

Refined success criteria
- Latency: p95 generation <= 250ms for single-turn queries at 20 QPS (document retrieval included).
- Quality: top-1 answer correctness >= 72% on our labeled evaluation set (we'll share ~800 labeled examples).
- Cost: target token cost <= $0.007 per call (rough threshold for our budget evaluation).

Security & data handling
- We'll provide a filtered dataset with PII redacted. We need written confirmation of: data-at-rest encryption, role-based access, and a SOC2 attestation or equivalent evidence for your hosted environment.

Timeline
- May 20 kickoff works for our product and infra leads. We expect to block 2 engineers for integration during Week 1.

If you can confirm the above and resend the POC plan with the success criteria section updated, we can sign off internally and schedule the kickoff.

Thanks,
Lauren McNamara
Director, Applied AI | ArdenHall Labs
lauren.mcnamara@ardenhall.com

On Thu, May 9, 2028 at 09:17 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> [original message quoted above]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren McNamara <lauren.mcnamara@ardenhall.com>, Ethan Mooney <ethan.mooney@ardenhall.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC activation plan — ArdenHall Labs

Thanks Lauren — really helpful specifics. Couple of notes and confirmations below.

On success criteria
- I'll update the attached POC PDF to reflect the latency (p95 <= 250ms), accuracy (>=72% top-1), and cost target you provided. That will be the primary pass/fail checklist at the end of Week 3.

On security / SOC2
- Redwood's hosted environment is SOC2 Type II compliant; I'll attach the SOC2 summary and a short note from our security team. For the POC we will:
  - provision a dedicated trial tenant with encrypted storage (AES-256),
  - limit access to named Redwood personnel and your team,
  - accept a filtered dataset (hashed IDs / redacted PII).

Trial access and onboarding
- Provisioning: we can provision the trial tenant and send trial-access-instructions.md once you confirm the kickoff week.
- Kickoff week: May 20 — propose Tue May 21 10:00 AM PT for a 45-minute kickoff (agenda: security signoff, ingestion checklist, evaluation cadence).

Action items I will own
- Update the POC-activation-plan-ardenhall.pdf to include your success criteria and SOC2 pointer (uploaded).
- Send a HubSpot kickoff link and DocuSign cover sheet for the trial agreement.

If that all looks good I’ll send calendar invites and the updated PDF by end of day.

Best,
Jonas

--
Attachments: POC-activation-plan-ardenhall.pdf (updated), SOC2-summary-redwood.pdf (summary), trial-access-instructions.md
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/meetings/1234567/jonas-weber-kickoff

I updated the POC PDF with the latency and accuracy numbers Lauren requested and attached a short ingest checklist for their infra team. I'll prepare a sanitized runbook for data handoff (PII redaction steps + example script) and a short verification test they can run to validate the tenant.

Ben — can you own the DocuSign cover sheet and confirm the trial tenant naming convention? I'll loop in EngOps if we need custom VPC peering.
